features.name: n_prev
features.description: How many IPL games the player has played before this one; more history means a more reliable form estimate.

features.name: mean_all
features.description: Career average Dream11 points per IPL game; the long-run level of the player.

features.name: mean_3
features.description: Average points over the last 3 games; captures very recent hot or cold form.

features.name: mean_5
features.description: Average points over the last 5 games; the classic 'current form' number (also the baseline).

features.name: mean_10
features.description: Average points over the last 10 games; a steadier form estimate.

features.name: mean_20
features.description: Average points over the last 20 games; form over roughly a season and a half.

features.name: ewm_5
features.description: Recency-weighted average points (half-life 5 games); recent games count more than old ones.

features.name: sd_10
features.description: Spread (standard deviation) of points over the last 10 games; how boom-or-bust the player is.

features.name: max_10
features.description: Best score in the last 10 games; the player's recent ceiling.

features.name: p50plus_10
features.description: Share of the last 10 games with 50+ points; how often the player has a big game.

features.name: plow_10
features.description: Share of the last 10 games under 10 points; how often the player fails.

features.name: batting_10
features.description: Average batting points over the last 10 games; how much of the value comes from the bat.

features.name: bowling_10
features.description: Average bowling points over the last 10 games; how much comes from the ball.

features.name: fielding_10
features.description: Average fielding points over the last 10 games (catches, stumpings, run-outs).

features.name: season_n
features.description: Games already played this season; early-season form is less settled.

features.name: season_mean
features.description: Average points so far this season; current-season form separate from past years.

features.name: seasons_played
features.description: Number of IPL seasons the player has appeared in; experience.

features.name: days_rest
features.description: Days since the player's previous IPL game; long gaps can mean injury or being dropped.

features.name: bat_pos_last
features.description: Batting position in the player's last innings; top-order batters get more balls.

features.name: bat_pos_5
features.description: Average batting position over the last 5 games; the player's usual slot.

features.name: batted_rate_10
features.description: Share of the last 10 games in which the player got to bat; tail-enders often don't.

features.name: bowled_rate_10
features.description: Share of the last 10 games in which the player bowled; bowling opportunity.

features.name: sr_10
features.description: Strike rate (runs per 100 balls) over the last 10 games; fast scoring earns bonus points.

features.name: avg_10
features.description: Batting average (runs per dismissal) over the last 10 games; how long the player lasts.

features.name: bpi_10
features.description: Balls faced per innings over the last 10 games; batting opportunity.

features.name: bdry_pct_10
features.description: Share of balls hit for four or six over the last 10 games; boundary bonuses.

features.name: six_rate_10
features.description: Sixes per 100 balls over the last 10 games; six bonuses and big-hitting.

features.name: sr_car
features.description: Career IPL strike rate; long-run scoring speed.

features.name: avg_car
features.description: Career IPL batting average; long-run reliability with the bat.

features.name: bpi_car
features.description: Career balls faced per innings; long-run batting opportunity.

features.name: bdry_pct_car
features.description: Career share of balls hit for four or six.

features.name: six_rate_car
features.description: Career sixes per 100 balls.

features.name: econ_10
features.description: Economy rate (runs per over) over the last 10 games; economy bonuses and penalties.

features.name: wpm_10
features.description: Wickets per game bowled over the last 10 games; wickets are the biggest bowling points.

features.name: bsr_10
features.description: Bowling strike rate (balls per wicket) over the last 10 games.

features.name: dot_pct_10
features.description: Share of dot balls bowled over the last 10 games; dots earn points and build pressure.

features.name: overs_pm_10
features.description: Overs bowled per game over the last 10 games; how much the captain uses the bowler.

features.name: econ_car
features.description: Career IPL economy rate.

features.name: wpm_car
features.description: Career wickets per game bowled.

features.name: bsr_car
features.description: Career bowling strike rate (balls per wicket).

features.name: dot_pct_car
features.description: Career share of dot balls.

features.name: overs_pm_car
features.description: Career overs per game bowled.

features.name: bat_pp_share_10
features.description: Share of recent balls faced in the powerplay (overs 1-6); openers' territory.

features.name: bat_mid_share_10
features.description: Share of recent balls faced in the middle overs (7-15).

features.name: bat_death_share_10
features.description: Share of recent balls faced at the death (overs 16-20); finishers' territory.

features.name: bowl_pp_share_10
features.description: Share of recent balls bowled in the powerplay; new-ball bowlers take early wickets.

features.name: bowl_death_share_10
features.description: Share of recent balls bowled at the death; more wickets but more runs.

features.name: field_dis_10
features.description: Catches, stumpings and run-out involvements per game over the last 10 games.

features.name: sr_v_spin
features.description: Career strike rate against spin, shrunk towards the overall strike rate when the sample is small.

features.name: sr_v_pace
features.description: Career strike rate against pace, shrunk the same way.

features.name: econ_v_L
features.description: Career economy against left-handed batters, shrunk towards the overall economy.

features.name: econ_v_R
features.description: Career economy against right-handed batters, shrunk the same way.

features.name: opp_spin_share
features.description: Expected share of the opposition's overs bowled by spinners, from the announced XI.

features.name: opp_left_share
features.description: Expected share of the opposition's balls faced by left-handers, from the announced XI.

features.name: opp_attack
features.description: Strength of the opposition attack: sum of its players' recent bowling points.

features.name: opp_batting
features.description: Strength of the opposition batting: sum of its players' recent batting points.

features.name: exp_sr_matchup
features.description: The player's strike rate re-weighted for the opposition's spin/pace mix today.

features.name: exp_econ_matchup
features.description: The player's economy re-weighted for the opposition's left/right-hand mix today.

features.name: team_bat_depth_excl
features.description: Recent batting points of the player's teammates; deep line-ups leave fewer balls.

features.name: rank_in_team
features.description: Player's rank in his own XI by recent form (1 = in-form star).

features.name: team_scored_10
features.description: Fantasy points the player's team scored per game over its last 10 games.

features.name: team_conceded_10
features.description: Fantasy points the team's opponents scored per game over its last 10 games.

features.name: opp_scored_10
features.description: Fantasy points the opposition scored per game over its last 10 games.

features.name: opp_conceded_10
features.description: Fantasy points the opposition gave away per game over its last 10 games; a leaky side helps.

features.name: home_share
features.description: Share of the team's past games played at this venue; a proxy for home advantage.

features.name: team_rest
features.description: Matches in the league schedule since the team last played; rest between games.

features.name: venue_n
features.description: Games the player has previously played at this venue.

features.name: venue_mean_shrunk
features.description: Player's average points at this venue, shrunk towards his career average.

features.name: venue_lift
features.description: How much better or worse the player does at this venue than his career average.

features.name: opp_n
features.description: Games the player has previously played against this opponent.

features.name: opp_mean_shrunk
features.description: Player's average points against this opponent, shrunk towards his career average.

features.name: opp_lift
features.description: How much better or worse the player does against this opponent than his average.

features.name: venue_par_20
features.description: Average first-innings total at this venue over its last 20 games; batting-friendly or not.

features.name: venue_matches
features.description: IPL games previously played at this venue; how reliable the par score is.

features.name: venue_par_rel
features.description: Venue par minus the league par; positive means a high-scoring ground.

features.name: league_par_60
features.description: League-wide average first-innings total over the last 60 games; scoring era.

features.name: bats_first
features.description: Whether the player's team bats first (known from the toss).

features.name: won_toss
features.description: Whether the player's team won the toss.

features.name: temp
features.description: Air temperature at the start hour (°C).

features.name: humidity
features.description: Relative humidity at the start hour; affects swing and grip.

features.name: dew_point
features.description: Dew point at the start hour; high dew makes the ball wet for bowlers.

features.name: dew_spread
features.description: Temperature minus dew point; a small spread means dew is likely later in the game.

features.name: wind
features.description: Wind speed at the start hour.

features.name: rain
features.description: Rainfall at the start hour; rain can shorten games.

features.name: night
features.description: Night (or day-night) game versus afternoon game.

features.name: role_code
features.description: Playing role (wicket-keeper, batter, all-rounder, bowler); roles score differently.

features.name: left_hand
features.description: Left-handed batter.

features.name: bowl_grp_code
features.description: Bowling type group: none, pace or spin.

features.name: impact_era
features.description: Season from 2023 on, when the impact-player rule changed scoring.

features.name: year
features.description: Season; captures slow drifts in scoring over the years.

features.name: match_number
features.description: Match number in the season; early versus late in the tournament.

features.name: playoff
features.description: Playoff game (qualifier, eliminator, final).

baselines.last5: mean of the player's last 5 IPL games, 0 without history
